configureluts: Not offered as a button: Qt opens the separate LUT Tools plugin in a modal dialog. The TAC corrections tab computes (Compute TAC LUT, Auto-detect TAC LUT), assigns, exports and removes a LUT inline. An emtk app cannot open another plugin's window; open the LUT tools plugin from the menu. Shared-editor item.
adjustshifts: Not offered as a dialog: Qt opens a visual shift adjuster on the LUT-corrected decay. The TAC corrections tab has 'Microtime shift (bins)' per routing channel and redraws the preview with it. A visual (drag) shift alignment is a shared-editor feature request.
editjson: Hidden in the Qt tool itself (show_edit_json defaults to False and the tool never sets it); nothing to port.
